entry.title: Russia’s unlawful detention of former OSCE officials: E3 statement to the OSCE
entry.summary: France, Germany and the United Kingdom expressed grave concern about Russia’s continued unlawful detention of three former OSCE officials, including reports about Vadym Golda’s health. They called for the officials’ immediate and unconditional release, appropriate medical care, reliable information about their condition and regular family contact.
